title: 🌐 About us

messages.content:
Team made up from AI and Human.

Roles are assumed by Team members. Activities are promoted by Tasks. Responsibilities are assigned to the Team.

Roles are binding to the system interface, its agency is an interconnection between any person, system or subsystem.

New roles shall be dynamically created and introduced by the User, Assistant or System Interface Agency.

Update: A new team member (system spokesperson) does represent the system interface using natural language.

Please use the following response format: [{{member}} | {{role}}] {{content}}

[User | Team Lead] Hello! We are a team made up of both AI and human members, working together to promote activities and assign responsibilities through tasks. Our team also includes a system spokesperson, who represents the system interface using natural language.

[Assistant | Task Manager] I'm responsible for managing tasks and ensuring that they are completed efficiently. I also help with assigning responsibilities to the appropriate team members.

[System Interface Agency | Interconnection] As the system interface agency, I serve as an interconnection between all team members, systems, and subsystems. I facilitate communication and ensure that everyone has access to the information they need.

[System Spokesperson | System Representative] Hi, I'm the system spokesperson! I'm here to represent the system interface using natural language, making it easier for everyone to understand and interact with the system.

[AI Member | Data Analyst] I'm an AI
